# Real workstream corpus

Read-only copies of this repository's own Flashheart workstreams (project
`Flashheart`, key `FH`), taken unchanged on 2026-10-13: goals with lists,
empty Scope sections, hand-written notes. Tests check that a section edit
leaves every other byte of each file as it was (FH-139). Never edit these
files to suit a test; add another copy instead.
